judge.summary: The patient requested to reschedule an existing appointment that did not exist in the system. The agent failed to verify the existence of the appointment and proceeded to 'reschedule' it without confirming the record. The agent ultimately booked a new appointment while falsely confirming the cancellation of the non-existent Tuesday slot.

conversation_quality.notes: The agent failed to address the logic of the request, simply accepting the patient's premise that an appointment existed.

agent_quality.notes: The agent hallucinated the existence of an appointment to 'reschedule' and falsely confirmed the cancellation of a non-existent visit.

technical_quality.notes: There was significant dead air (approx 49 seconds) between the patient's initial request and the agent's response.

candidate_issues.title: Hallucinated appointment rescheduling
candidate_issues.quote: I can certainly help you reschedule your appointment
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have stated they could not find an appointment for Tuesday and offered to book a new one instead.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: It misleads the patient into believing a record exists and that a cancellation occurred, which could lead to confusion or missed billing/scheduling issues.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent "confirms" rescheduling an appointment that does not exist (hallucinated record)

candidate_issues.title: False confirmation of cancellation
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have clarified that no appointment existed to cancel.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: Confirming the cancellation of a non-existent appointment creates a false record of the patient's history.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent leaves the status of the original Tuesday appointment ambiguous
